units.source_text: 我这个观战记者，好奇心很强。

en.t: As a reporter watching the match, I was intensely curious.

units.source_text: 名人作为竞赛中的英雄，吸引了我。

en.t: The Master, as the hero of the contest, drew me in.

units.source_text: 我听到他妻子的话，仿佛被人捅到痛处，无言可对了。

en.t: When I heard his wife's words, it was as if someone had touched a sore spot, and I had no reply.
